name: impactor-mcp
description: Sign, install and manage sideloaded iOS apps with the Impactor sideloader.
long_description: Lets any AI agent do everything the Impactor sideloader does: sign in with an Apple ID (including 2FA), manage developer-portal certificates, devices and app IDs, sign and install .ipa files with tweaks, install pairing files, and refresh apps before they expire. Shares account data with the stock Impactor app.

auto_refresh.title: Auto-refresh apps
auto_refresh.description: Re-sign saved apps in the background before their profiles expire. Leave off if the Impactor app's own refresh daemon is running.
